subject: Marine Works - Ile aux Coudres - west - Saint-Bernard-sur-Mer
text:
Marine Works - Ile aux Coudres - west - Saint-Bernard-sur-Mer
Dredging operations taking place daily 24 hours a day in the vicinity of 47 25.256N 070 23.551W beginning 11 Nov 2026. Barges and workboats on site. 
Minimum wake requested. Stay clear 500 metres.
